sentences.text:
CM APPL. 25502/2023 -Ex.
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

CM APPL. 25501/2023 -Delay 81 days.
3. This is an application filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 81 days delay in filing the appeal.
4. Issue notice.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.3 accepts notice and fairly does not oppose the application.
5. The application is, accordingly, for the reasons stated therein, allowed.
Consequently, the delay in filing the appeal is condoned.
6. The application stands disposed of.
7. The present appeal preferred by the claimant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by This is a digitally signed order.
